text: ニャース　って　ちょー　かわいーの！

structure.jp: ちょー　かわいーの！

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って is a casual way to bring up what you are going to talk about, like は. ニャース って = 'Meowth, you know'.

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: の at the end adds a soft, eager tone of telling you something, often in girls' speech. かわいーの = 'it's so cute, you know'.
